headline: TEX @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 5.93 at COL 4.42, with a projected total of 10.36. The projected total climbed +0.55, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Hunter Goodman, Ezequiel Duran, Jake McCarthy, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Edouard Julien because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
